Name: baby-faced pigs
Author: deleted43331542
Description:
A very simple mod that replaces the grown pig's head with its former baby self, to create chubby and snouty freaks of nature. Just a littlething I did for myself and thought I'd share.

1. Navigate to your Stardew Valley/Content/Animals folder     [Steam/steamapps/common]
2. Backup Pig.xnb file if you'd like   
3. Swap the original Pig.xnb with the one provided
